This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

params.name: role
params.description:
Filters the result based on the authenticated user's role on each repository.

* **member**: returns repositories to which the user has explicit read access
* **contributor**: returns repositories to which the user has explicit write access
* **admin**: returns repositories to which the user has explicit administrator access
* **owner**: returns all repositories owned by the current user

params.name: q
params.description: Query string to narrow down the response as per [filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).

params.name: sort
params.description: Field by which the results should be sorted as per [filtering and sorting](/cloud/bitbucket/rest/intro/#filtering).

items.docs: This API operation creates a fork of an existing Bitbucket repository within a specified workspace. By sending a POST request to the endpoint with the workspace identifier and repository slug, users can duplicate the repository into their own account or another workspace they have access to. The forked repository maintains a connection to the original source repository, allowing users to track changes and potentially submit pull requests back to the parent repository.
